thread:
kari: heads up - multiple CI jobs for release v1.12.0-rc1 are failing during postbuild verify. Not seeing network errors, it's checksum mismatch on the uploaded wheel.

qa-bot: failed artifact verify for artifact wheel://pkg-1.12.0-rc1.whl -> checksum mismatch (expected 0x9f7a -> got 0x4b2c). seen by runners: ci-runner-11, ci-runner-27.

tony: interesting. we've seen transient mirror locks lately but checksums usually only flip on upload truncation or multipart reassembly bugs. can someone paste the deploy-bot upload log?

deploy-bot: upload failed: PUT https://mirror-us-east-1/internal/artifacts/pkg-1.12.0-rc1.whl: 200 OK, content-length mismatch on finalize step. wrote 14,392,731 bytes, backend reported 14,392,014 bytes. retry attempts exhausted.

ana: two immediate choices: 1) revert the promote and pin to last-good (pkg-1.11.3-sha: d0e1f2), run promote to meet customer deployments; 2) block the change window and force a reupload from CI with artifact verification loop. Option 2 risks demo delays.

manu: if we pin, need to add a note in release-notes and post a short rollback summary for the ops runbook. Also check that config schema for feature flags matches older artifact (schema bump was minimal but worth verifying).

sre-oncall: I'm seeing high variance in our object-store finalization latencies ~10:42-10:55UTC. mitigation: increase multipart chunk timeout to reduce truncation under slow IB; patch command: ```kubectl -n infra exec -it objstore-0 -- /bin/sh -c 'echo "multipart.timeout=120s" >> /etc/objstore/config && svcctl reload objstore'``` monitoring tail: https://metrics.internal/objstore/multipart

kari: customer-facing demo scheduled 12:00 local. ops prefers we don't block. leaning to option 1 (pin to last-good) and follow-up root-cause. who can run manual promote + docs?

tony: infra will run the promote and watch canaries. suggest also temporarily enabling extra verification in deploy-bot to fail-fast on size delta so we don't promote bad artifacts again. I can open a quick PR to add size/hash double-check.

ana: ack. i'll update release-notes and add a clear sentence: "Promoted package v1.11.3 (pinned) due to artifact verification failures for v1.12.0-rc1; investigation underway."

release-coordinator: creating RD-9351 to track artifact-truncation postmortem, will link to release board and notify support to hold off escalations. tracker: https://tracker.internal/rd/9351

kari: manu, can you prepare a one-paragraph ops brief and a rollback tag in the changelog? also please include verification steps to rerun v1.12.0-rc1 once objstore latencies normalize.

manu: on it. will push brief to /docs/releases/notes and add verification checklist.

deploy-bot: manual promote started by tony at 1745700005; promote steps: step1 snapshot create -> success; step2 route update -> success; step3 canary rollout -> triggered (3/3 healthy so far); step4 finalize -> pending. will post final status.

qa-bot: queueing a reupload job to attempt re-produce the truncation locally for debugging. job id: job-7753.

kari: thanks team. proceeding with manual pin and promote to keep change window. will update if canary rolls back or deploy-bot reports errors.

tony: will monitor metrics and abort promote if we see artifact errors in canaries. :eyes:
